products.description:
Stand up a working Microsoft Intune — free

Turning on device management shouldn't take a consultant or a week of trial and error. This free Quick-Start takes you from no device management to a functioning Microsoft Intune in a single short session — whether you're standing up a brand-new Microsoft 365 tenant or enabling Intune for the first time in an existing one. When you finish, Intune is your enrollment authority, the sensible defaults are in place, and you can enroll and manage a Windows PC and an iPhone end to end.

A real preview of the whole catalog

This is a genuinely useful deliverable and a free preview of how every paid solution is built. Same click-by-click house style, same tested PowerShell, same pilot-first method — so you know exactly what to expect before you ever buy.

  • Simpler — exact navigation in the right order, written for a novice admin. Every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Faster — the smallest correct set of steps to a working Intune, not an exhaustive tome. Under an hour of tenant-side work.
  • Proven — a pilot-first path (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with read-only scripts that verify the tenant and score the enablement PASS/FAIL.

What you'll accomplish

  • Confirm licensing and set Intune as the MDM authority.
  • Add the Apple MDM push certificate so iPhones and iPads can enroll.
  • Turn on automatic Windows enrollment for Entra-joined PCs.
  • Apply a minimal baseline (one compliance policy per platform, one config profile).
  • Enroll a Windows device and an iPhone and confirm both check in and report compliant.

Where the boundary is — and where to go next

Personal/BYOD iPhone enrollment works with only the Intune-side steps here. Corporate, zero-touch iPhone enrollment (Automated Device Enrollment) additionally requires Apple Business Manager — an Apple portal outside Intune. This guide shows exactly where ABM fits and points you to the dedicated catalog solution, “Implement Entra ID Integration with ABM for Account Auto Provisioning for Microsoft Intune,” which walks Apple Business Manager setup end to end. Once Intune is live, the catalog continues in the same style: Windows Autopilot, Conditional Access, compliance at scale, and app deployment.

The bottom line

In one session you get a real, working Intune managing Windows and iOS — and a clear, no-obligation look at how every solution in this catalog is delivered. Start here, then expand when you're ready.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ITSTART-Compliance-Check.ps1 — summarizes baseline compliance-policy assignments and device state
    • ITSTART-Discovery.ps1 — reports Intune enablement readiness for the tenant
    • ITSTART-Enrollment-Readiness.ps1 — checks whether a specific user can enroll a device
    • ITSTART-Report.ps1 — lists enrolled devices with platform, ownership, management, and compliance
    • ITSTART-Validate.ps1 — scores the Intune enablement against the Quick-Start success criteria

Delivered free as a single Complete Solution Package: this guide as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts — yours to keep.
